note: Primary maker credit and public reference index for the seven Dodem clan-animal sculptures. Source facts and captions only; the model did not inspect image pixels. No coordinates are invented. Reference images are private under /tmp and are not committed.

primaryCredit.text: Dodem animal sculptures by APE Richter/Christian Huba in consultation with MCFN and MinoKamik Collective
primaryCredit.source: City of Toronto 2026 Port Lands open-house planning boards, page 5 (zero-index 4), 'Indigenous Presence on the Waterfront'
primaryCredit.supersedes: Earlier assumption that the City published no sculptor name.
primaryCredit.notCurrent: The 2023 Destination Playground boards (moose/bear/fireboat) are a future proposal and must not be used as the current Dodem design.

maker.designerStudio: Aschau im Chiemgau, Upper Bavaria, Germany
construction: relief cuts in the centre of the trunk to control cracking
weather-hard wood with strong eccentric grain
intended to be stroked, touched, sat on and played with
maker.copyright: Designs are the intellectual property of Richter Spielgeräte GmbH; Christian Huba is the licenser and idea provider. Images/sketches may not be reused without consent. Reference photos are private-only; no pixels, sketches or 3D models are shipped.

bear.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview; workshop photo 'Christian Huba bei der Arbeit am Bär' (© Huba); City 2026 crop shows an upright carved bear in the background left (captain note).

beaver.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview; Richter programme gallery beaver; City 2026 crop shows a round beaver-like form in the right foreground (captain note).

otter.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview; Richter programme gallery otter; City 2026 crop shows a long low otter-like form in the left foreground (captain note).

wolf.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview; workshop photo captioned 'Eine Wölfin mit ihren Jungen' (a mother wolf with her cubs), © Blum.

eagle.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview; 'Der Adler' photo (© Blum); City primary eagle photo captain/dodem-eagle.jpg already viewed by the captain (natural carved brown wood body, black chest, white head, yellow hooked beak, folded brown wings).

musky.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview as 'Moschus (ein Fisch)' — a fish, i.e. muskellunge. No individual as-built photo located.

turtle.evidence: Named in chiemgau24 maker interview; made of five parts and weighs about as much as a Fiat Panda (~1 tonne); 'Die Schildkröte' photo (© Huba).

makerFacts.shipping: truck to Hamburg, then container ship to Toronto, for a spring park opening
makerFacts.indigenousConsultation: Shelley Charles (community spokesperson) guided the design; City credit names MCFN and MinoKamik Collective
makerFacts.symbolicConstraints: An animal on its back symbolises death; on its belly, illness.

catalogUncertainty.note: The Richter catalogue 'Animals for Canada' set is a generic Canada design set, not the exact seven Biidaasige Dodems. It is related maker material, not proof of the as-built Biidaasige forms.

placement.note: No individual animal points are published or in OSM. Do not invent coordinates. Relative positions may be estimated later by the captain from the City crop and site context.
